title: Unbroadcast a Gradient
signature: def unbroadcast(grad: np.ndarray, shape: tuple) -> np.ndarray
hints: Broadcasting aligns shapes from the RIGHT. Extra leading axes in grad were added by broadcasting.
Sum away the extra leading axes first. Then grad has as many dims as the target.
Every axis where the target has size 1 but grad doesn't was stretched. Sum it with keepdims=True.
